_comment: Frozen setup. The filename IS the hash of the canonical fields below, so editing this file in place breaks the registry. To change a setup, change the matrix and let a new file be written.

full._comment: Inherited by every arm; an arm may override any of these. These are the fields that enter the setup hash, so changing one here re-hashes every arm. turn_limit is a runaway guard, now actually applied on the API arm via harbor's --agent-kwarg max_turns (claude-code and terminus-2 declare the flag; codex does not, so gpt arms are uncapped). 200 is ~2x the worst case measured over 30 collected runs (max 106 steps), so it cannot truncate legitimate work. It is NOT a cost control: cost tracks per-step thinking, not step count.
full.name: opus55
